- Speed up the Basecamp ranges
- Fix the Windows tray menu

## Install

- **macOS** (13 or later): download `Trek-0.2.0-beta.2-darwin-aarch64.dmg` for Apple silicon or `Trek-0.2.0-beta.2-darwin-x86_64.dmg` for an Intel Mac, open it and drag **Trek** onto **Applications**. Apple hasn't notarized Trek, so macOS won't open it the first time: click **Done**, then in **System Settings › Privacy & Security** scroll to **Security**, click **Open Anyway** beside "Trek was blocked" and **Open Anyway** again. It asks only once. (`Trek-0.2.0-beta.2-darwin-aarch64.app.tar.gz` and `Trek-0.2.0-beta.2-darwin-x86_64.app.tar.gz` are the same apps as archives: unpack yours and move **Trek.app** to Applications.)
- **Windows**: run `Trek-Setup-x86_64.exe`. It installs for you alone and asks for no administrator. SmartScreen warns once: **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Updates install in place from Settings → Updates. (`Trek-0.2.0-beta.2-windows-x86_64.zip` is the same app without an installer: unzip it into a folder of its own that Windows doesn't guard, such as `C:\Users\<you>\Trek` or `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Trek`, not Documents, Desktop, Downloads or Program Files, and run `trek.exe`.)
